_serviceNote: The MCP measurement-server endpoint was removed 2026-08-19: GET on the advertised worker returns 404 and a DID document must not advertise a dead service. It returns in the same commit that redeploys a live endpoint. This apex copy now matches that rule.

_keyContinuity.note: Three signing identities per KEY-CONTINUITY.md. #site-release-1 signs site artifacts (keystone-held). #estate-chain-1 signs fleet chains, measurement cards and boards (pod-held). #card-attestation-1 (THE BRICK, estate key d4cb0eaa, Mac-held) signs carded measurement receipts, the corrections ledger and MANIFEST cards; published 2026-08-20 after its signatures verified under the published canon (stranger-verifiable against did.json). Ed25519 today; ML-DSA-65 is roadmap, not present.

superseded.reason: Published 2026-08-17 from a generation script, not from the production keystone; no estate artifact was ever validly signed with this key and its private half is not held. Superseded per KEY-CONTINUITY rule 4. Any artifact claiming this key and not verifiable against the two keys above is not ours.

_boardAttestationNote: #board-attestation-1 signs the PUBLIC BOARD SNAPSHOT as served by the site (integrity of /api/gspc), distinct from #estate-chain-1 (pod measurement chains). Born and held in Cloudflare; private half never leaves.
_cardAttestationNote: #card-attestation-1 (d4cb0eaa) signs the 3KB ed25519 h3k measurement cards, the corrections ledger and the MANIFEST card chain. Private half held on the estate Mac only; never in CI, never in this repo.
_pqcNote: #board-pqc-1 ABSENT (UNMEASURED). No ML-DSA public key is published in this document. Do not generate one off-keystone. ML-DSA-65 signatures are ~3.3KB and cannot live inside the 3KB card atom. Hybrid is a second receipt on root/DID, never inside the card. Ed25519 is not replaced. PQCBench is the GSPC continuity arena (csoai/gspc-asi), not a PQC signature. Live Pages may still omit #board-attestation-1 on assertionMethod until this repo is promoted.
